description: Photographed terrestrial globe with geographic coordinate references.

images.title: A terrestrial globe and geographic coordinates
images.summary: A photograph of a physical Earth globe mounted on a tilted axis, showing Asia and the Indian Ocean with geographic reference lines.
images.alt: A blue globe on a black stand with colored continents, printed reference lines and geographic labels.
images.caption: Latitude measures angular distance north or south of the equator; longitude measures angular position relative to a conventional reference meridian. The globe is a human-made model, and its political boundaries are historical conventions, not physical divisions.
